query:
SELECT 
  'Festas Realizadas (até 27/11/2025)' as categoria,
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal)/100 as valor_total,
  SUM(valorPago)/100 as valor_pago,
  SUM(valorTotal - valorPago)/100 as saldo_devedor
FROM festas 
WHERE dataFesta <= '2025-11-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Festas Agendadas (após 27/11/2025)' as categoria,
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal)/100 as valor_total,
  SUM(valorPago)/100 as valor_pago,
  SUM(valorTotal - valorPago)/100 as saldo_devedor
FROM festas 
WHERE dataFesta > '2025-11-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'TOTAL GERAL' as categoria,
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal)/100 as valor_total,
  SUM(valorPago)/100 as valor_pago,
  SUM(valorTotal - valorPago)/100 as saldo_devedor
FROM festas;
